summary.intent: Select and implement GSD todo #9 — make CipherBoxClient self-bootstrap its folderTree from the root IPNS key so every folderTree-dependent method can lazy-load without the web layer pre-seeding it.
summary.outcome: Implemented `ensureFolderLoaded` + `requireFolder` chokepoint, added `rootIpnsKeypair` to the SDK config, wired the web to pass the key, ran /simplify + CodeRabbit + security reviews (all clean), merged PR #498, and captured follow-up todos on main.

repo: CipherBoxClientConfig had `rootIpnsName` + `rootFolderKey` but NO root IPNS Ed25519 signing keypair — the web's `vaultStore.rootIpnsKeypair` existed and was guarded non-null but was never passed to the SDK constructor.

`registerFolder` (client.ts:288) and `loadFolder` (client.ts:345) are the ONLY two folderTree entry points; every other writer requires the folder to already be present — no lazy-load existed before this change.
`withOperation` is reentrant-safe (emits events only, no lock) — calling it from inside `ensureFolderLoaded` which is itself called from within another `withOperation` body is safe.
`unwrapKey` and `hexToBytes` are already exported from `@cipherbox/crypto`; client.ts already imports `clearBytes` from the same package.
`integration.test.ts` is `describe.skip` when `CI=1` (needs live backend at localhost:3000); run with `CI=1 pnpm test` to get a true unit-only pass count.
GitHub Actions bot pushes a `chore(release)` commit to a branch immediately after a PR is created, causing 1-ahead/1-behind divergence that requires a rebase before pushing again.
`gsd_run query commit` reliably reports a false-negative `commit_failed` — `git log` is the authoritative confirmation that the commit actually landed.
The `pnpm typecheck` root script rebuilds the full dependency chain and then runs web `tsc -b` — the correct command to validate any public SDK API change.
`.planning/security/` already had a substantial collection of prior security review reports before this session.

code.finding: CipherBoxClientConfig: has `rootIpnsName` (string) and `rootFolderKey` (Uint8Array) but no root IPNS Ed25519 keypair — the gap that prevented self-bootstrap. `rootIpnsKeypair` was added here.
FolderState holds the per-folder Ed25519 `ipnsKeypair` — non-root folders already had their signing key stored here; root folder had no entry until something registered it.

CipherBoxClient private fields: `folderTree` is `FolderTree` (Map<string,FolderState>), `internalVaultKeypair`/`internalRootFolderKey` are defensive copies from config — NOT named `vaultKeypair`/`rootFolderKey` as fields.
`registerFolder` — the synchronous entry point for writing folderTree; caller must supply `ipnsKeypair`. No path here reads `config.rootIpnsName` into folderTree.
`loadFolder(ipnsName, folderKey, ipnsKeypair)` — the async IPNS-backed load primitive. New `ensureFolderLoaded` DFS calls this for each subfolder in the walk path.

`collectSubtreeIpnsNames` — pre-existing DFS helper; confirmed the child `FolderEntry` shape (has `ipnsName`, `folderKeyEncrypted`, `ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted`) used in the new `ensureFolderLoaded` walk.
Guard that ensures `vaultStore.rootIpnsKeypair` is non-null before initializing the SDK client — already existed, so passing it into the new config field required only a one-line addition.
Bin restore calls with no folder seeding — the concrete pre-existing bug that `ensureFolderLoaded` fixes. `recycle-bin.spec.ts` missed this because it never reloads.
The reload model used in the existing E2E suite — referenced as the pattern to follow when writing the new `bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts`.

workflow: Running 4 parallel /simplify review agents (reuse/simplification/efficiency/altitude) converged on the `requireFolder` chokepoint as the #1 fix with 3-of-4 independent agreement — the parallelism was key to catching it.
CodeRabbit CLI `--agent` mode streams JSON to stdout; exit code 0 + `findings: 0` in the completion payload is the clean-bill signal.

After PR merge, applying skipped commits to main requires: `git reset HEAD~1` (uncommit), `git stash push -- <specific files>`, `git checkout main`, `git pull`, `git stash pop`. Pre-existing unstaged files (Cargo.lock) must be stashed separately first.

Security review report files in `.planning/security/` add ceremony without signal when the diff introduces no new crypto primitives — the project-level security reviewer agent + CodeRabbit coverage is sufficient.

friction: `gsd_run query commit` reports `commit_failed` as a false-negative — requires a manual `git log` verification after every GSD commit call.
GitHub Actions bot pushes a `chore(release)` commit immediately after PR creation, forcing a rebase before any subsequent push to the branch.
Pre-existing unstaged `Cargo.lock` blocked the rebase step, requiring a double-stash dance (stash Cargo.lock, rebase, then stash pop + restore).
The todo commit was pushed to the feature branch after the PR was already merged, requiring a full stash/checkout-main/pop recovery workflow.
TypeScript errors in the new `ensureFolderLoaded` method (`FolderState | undefined` vs `| null` from `.get()`) required a second typecheck round after the initial implementation.
open_items: Delete ~16 redundant web `ensureFolderRegistered` calls and the duplicate `useFolderNavigation` ECIES unwrap path — safe once self-bootstrap proves out in production (captured as todo #9 on main).
Optional negative-cache in `ensureFolderLoaded` for unresolvable targets — only worth adding if upstream code introduces retry loops on bad targets.
New `bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts` E2E test is committed but web-e2e runs only on main-push (not PRs) — first live validation is deferred to the next main push.
Todo + STATE.md changes are uncommitted on local main (direct push to main is blocked) — needs a small `docs/` branch + PR to persist, or a local commit.
